judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update, and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code. None of the required changes in `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, or `src/config.ts` were made. Because the implementation is completely missing, the newly added acceptance tests will fail at runtime and compilation (`history: {enabled: true}` is not even a valid option on `createServer`). Furthermore, required documentation updates in `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` are entirely absent.
